rubric.evidence: IDL and ABNF quoted verbatim from https://www.w3.org/TR/device-memory/ (fetched 2026-09-06); clamp constants quoted from Chromium approximated_device_memory.cc at trunk (kMinMemory 2/kMaxMemory 32, Android 1/8) which reproduce exactly the value sets in the chromestatus summary and BCD's Chrome 147 notes. PR #53 merge state (2026-01-19) verified. No invented members.
rubric.notes: The intent thread originally targeted M146; the page states this and defers to the milestone=147 listing, which is authoritative for gendn.

rubric.evidence: Feature 6330376953921536 appears in /api/v0/features?milestone=147 under 'Enabled by default' (fetched 2026-09-06); H1 is the listing name 'Update Device Memory API limits'; slug matches the server slugify of the listing name.

reference-contract.json inventories the migration, the coarsening algorithm, and the three affected surfaces, all nine dimensions mapped to rendered anchors; claims implementation-sufficient. Base-API depth (e.g. full Accept-CH/Client Hints lifecycle) is deliberately delegated to the linked MDN reference since MDN owns the base API.
rubric.notes: The Sec-CH-Device-Memory vs legacy Device-Memory dual-send behavior is documented from BCD; the Chromium code path for header emission was not independently read.

rubric.evidence: Rounding-then-clamping is explained with the verbatim spec clamp steps and the trunk constants, deriving the bucket sets rather than asserting them; migration impact bullets spell out which comparisons become dead code (< 1 on Android, < 2 on desktop).

Three <pre><code> examples (bucket read + migration-safe tiering, Accept-CH exchange) plus the memory-inspector showcase demo embedded as a lazy iframe (HEAD 200, HTML content-type, no X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors restriction — all verified by curl 2026-09-06) and four more demos text-linked. The writer sandbox's headless Chrome cannot complete external TLS through its proxy (no certutil to install the proxy CA), so the iframe body shows as unloaded in the writer screenshots; in-frame rendering needs integrator confirmation in an unproxied browser.
rubric.notes: Same-origin page assets all load; the conformance no-failed-requests assertion filters to same-origin, so the sandbox TLS limitation does not mask a page bug.

rubric.evidence: Per-version table built from fetched BCD JSON for api.Navigator.deviceMemory (63), api.WorkerNavigator.deviceMemory (65), http.headers.Sec-CH-Device-Memory (97, alt name since 61), http.headers.Device-Memory (61, deprecated), each row linking its BCD key; Baseline banner honestly reports 'Limited availability' per webstatus.dev; undefined-guard fallback shown in the example.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation data tables mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Lean on intrinsic sizing and the browser layout engine; track overflow deliberately rather than letting wide content break the viewport.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Wide compat and value tables are wrapped in .table-wrap { overflow-x: auto } with a min-width on the multi-column tables so they scroll internally at 360px instead of overflowing the page; overflow-wrap: anywhere on code/cells.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: mobile screenshot shows no page-level horizontal scroll; conformance overflow assertions target scrollWidth <= innerWidth+1

guidanceConsulted.query: lazy loading iframe embed third-party demo performance
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use loading="lazy" on below-the-fold iframes; never lazy-load above-the-fold content; give embeds explicit dimensions to avoid layout shift.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The showcase iframe sits far below the fold in the examples section and carries loading="lazy", width="100%" and height="520" (fixed height, no CLS).
guidanceConsulted.evidence: iframe markup in #examples; desktop screenshot shows demo loaded without layout shift artifacts

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible code blocks pre semantic markup readability semantic tables
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use caption and th scope for data tables; keep one h1 and real heading hierarchy; prefer native naming (figcaption for figures).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Added <caption> to the value and compat tables, scope=col on all thead cells and scope=row in the at-a-glance table; the embed uses figure/figcaption; heading structure is one h1 + h2 sections.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: DOM dump grep: 2 captions, th scope attributes present, exactly one h1
